title: Global factorization of the finite dualizing mate
statement: The global finite dualizing comparison factors as a composite of two invertible maps through an intermediate derived object.

proof.text: The global comparison is an isomorphism by the closed-chart descent and affine-space comparison, with the affine cover reflecting isomorphisms.
Factor the comparison through its codomain using the comparison itself followed by the identity; the identity is invertible and the composite is the comparison by the right identity law.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDualizing_etaleComparison_factorization (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∃ (Z : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n) X)
      (g : (Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E h) X).obj
        (finiteDualizingEtaleTerm l E D X m) ⟶ Z)
      (k : Z ⟶ finiteDualizingEtaleTerm l E D X n),
      IsIso g ∧ IsIso k ∧
        finiteDualizingEtaleComparison l E D X h = g ≫ k
